card.title: KURSK
card.text: The Battle of Kursk was history's largest tank battle.
card.flavorText: The Battle of Kursk, fought from July 5th to August 23rd, 1943, was WWII's largest tank battle and a crucial confrontation on the Eastern Front. Following the Soviet victory at Stalingrad, the Germans launched Operation Citadel to encircle Soviet forces in the Kursk salient. However, the Soviets had fortified their defenses, effectively countering the German attacks. The battle resulted in heavy losses on both sides, but the Soviets emerged victorious, marking a turning point in the war. This defeat halted the German advance and allowed the Soviets to gain the initiative, leading to a series of offensives that pushed the Germans back.
